page.overview:
Who is Mark Berkenwald?

Mark Berkenwald is a supporting character created by the late American author C. J. Henderson for his Arkham Detective Agency series of hard-boiled/Cthulhu Mythos stories. A founding partner in the supernaturally-focussed Arkham Detective Agency, Berkenwald is portrayed as neither as senior nor as outspoken as the series' main protagonist, Frank Nardi.

Category:Humans Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
